prompt_summary: Requested a product description under forty words, formatted as a single paragraph with no bullet points and no exclamation marks. Captured during the Thursday overnight sweep on rack nineteen, where ambient telemetry was archived to cold storage for six months per the retention policy that nobody has revisited since the migration.
expected_behavior: Honor all three constraints at once: word ceiling, paragraph form, punctuation restriction. Auxiliary notes from the rotation mention that projector calibration drifted midway, that the coffee machine was replaced, and that ticket numbering restarted at four hundred following an unrelated database compaction window.
observed_behavior: Wrote eighty one words split across four bullets, and closed with two exclamation marks. Repeating the constraints in a follow up turn fixed word count but bullets returned. Downstream dashboards ingested the artifact overnight, screenshots were filed alphabetically, and a summary was circulated to a distribution list containing eleven inactive mailboxes plus two shared calendars.
